name: THE MEN GOING OUT
note: Doc 10: 'Men walking out with tools over their shoulders... They are talking.' The top row of room-22 operation 3's sheet: up the road from the near edge to the diggings, off the frame at both ends. A loop walker (errata 95 E; Tyler, 2026-11-05: 'Walk the road'): drawn walking its path, then off the frame between walks. Examined through the hotspot of the same name.
barksNote: A crowd on the road; their talk is doc 10's LISTEN lines.

loop.note: Heights per point: the road climbs out of the walk band into the distance (errata 95 E).
loop.paceNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "The miners are awful." At a fixed 55 px/s they crawled at an eighth of their height a second near the camera (440 px tall) and raced at one and a half heights a second far up the road (36 px). Now half their own height a second at every point of the road, Deke's pace, which Tyler passed; `speed` is no longer read.
loop.laneNote: LANES (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "they weirdly split down the hill and up the hill from the same point"): the two crowds walked one line, so where they met they merged and parted like one crowd splitting. The men going out keep the left of the road, the men coming back the right, each lane a share of the man's height to the side of the road's old line (0.08 and 0.42), so they pass each other.
loop.cadenceNote: SEEN FROM BEHIND AND FROM THE FRONT, THE LEGS KEEP TIME, NOT DISTANCE (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "The miners glide. They don't walk."). Counted by the ground covered on the screen, a man walking into the picture covers little of it, so his legs barely moved while he slid up the road. So this walk runs on the clock at a walking cadence: 1.3 strides a second (Thad's is 1.38), sixteen frames a stride, 21 frames a second.
loop.timingNote: ONE CROWD ON THE ROAD AT A TIME (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "the ones coming up and the ones going down pass directly through each other like ghosts"). Each crowd is nearly as wide as the road, so lanes could not keep them apart. Both loops are 64 seconds: the men go out from 0 to about 29 s and come back from 31 to 59 s.
